image_description: A close-up view of an ornate, historical metal breastplate (cuirass). The armor is made of polished steel or iron with significant gilding and etched decorative patterns. It features a central vertical ridge, embossed floral or heraldic motifs, and rows of brass rivets along the shoulder and side edges. The surface shows signs of age and patina but retains high reflectivity.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar metallic objects or costumes.
To analyze the realism of the complex reflections and etched textures, ensuring no AI-generated smearing or pattern repetition.
To verify the structural integrity of the rivets and the sharpness of the armor's boundary against the background.

focus_areas: Consistency of etched patterns (no melting or gibberish)
Realism of metallic reflections and patina
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the etched designs; AI often fails to maintain consistent line width or creates nonsensical symbols in detailed engravings. Verify that the rivets appear physically attached rather than floating or painted on.
